hooks.command: sh -c 's="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/greprules-hook.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s" readiness; fi; printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"greprules plugin cache changed while this Codex session was open. Start a new Codex session to reload greprules.\"}}"'

sh -c 's="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/greprules-hook.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s" mark-dirty; fi; printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"greprules plugin cache changed while this Codex session was open. Start a new Codex session to reload greprules.\"}}"'

sh -c 's="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/greprules-hook.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s" scan-if-dirty; fi; printf "%s\n" "{\"continue\":true,\"systemMessage\":\"greprules plugin cache changed while this Codex session was open. Start a new Codex session to reload greprules.\"}"'
